snippet.title: Sword of the Apocalypse GBC 20:43
snippet.description:
Sword of the Apocalypse Game Boy Color speedrun in 20:43

New homebrew platformer where you choose your character and the level plays out differently. The final level is completely different depending on the character, the sword is faster + less cutscenes too. This was a deathless attempt which was my goal, boss rng patterns were sometimes rough. The game suffers from GB studio physics where sometimes your attacks don't register or jump inputs are eaten. Graphics and music is fantastic.

support the dev: https://gunsavior.itch.io/sword-of-the-apocalypse

Played on Bizhawk

-- Watch live at https://www.twitch.tv/rayquaza911
